Class ProductInfo

java.lang.Object
org.csystem.util.datasource.product.ProductInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<ProductInfo>
public class ProductInfo extends Object implements Comparable<ProductInfo>
Represents a product with pricing, stock, and cost information.

Uses a fluent setter API (each setter returns this) to enable method chaining. Products are naturally ordered by price (ascending) via Comparable.
